'''Deara Antilles''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the sister of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Organa]]. Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], she served as her sister's [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] and the caretaker of Breha's adopted daughter, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]]. However, unbeknownst to her relatives, Antilles was actually working as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], after the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] threatened her while she was on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After she was discovered by [[Ferus Olin]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], Breha had mercy on her sister and exiled her to [[Ankori-7]].<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception" />
